svg.text: Grid: 8 x 8 blocks here (cap 8 wide by 10 tall, 80 blocks).
One block = 16 x 16 cells. A Hob in a Nook stands about 26 cells tall.
The fort never tilts. It rests on its Stompers on the highest ground.
